quantifiers.about: the language models the published study tested
set: the three open source large language models UT Southwestern's October 20th release says the study tested (c9), which the release does not name
quantifiers.why: The universal is over the study's own three models and nothing wider. c13 says all three identified higher risk patients at rates well above chance before any detail was added. It says nothing of other models or of AI triage in general.
